_comment: Pre-registration for the county restriction model (docs/predictive_foundation_design.md, section 4). Committed before any model was fit; a change after the first fit is a new registration with its own date and reason, appended to amendments, never an edit in place. Only the label counts in docs/predictive_foundation_design.md (descriptive, no model) had been looked at when this was written.
approved_plan: Price approved the plan and its four decisions on 2026-10-15, including the prospective label as primary.

amendments.change: log1p_solar_mw and log1p_wind_mw as of 2021: a retired plant counts when it retired after 2021, not when its year is 2021 or earlier.
amendments.reason: For a retired plant, facilities.csv's year is EIA's retirement year, not its operating year, so the registered wording counted plants already closed by the cut (104) and missed plants still running then (80). Found while checking the first fit; 184 plants, 2.5 GW in all. The snapshot definition (operating or retired, any year) is unchanged.

frame: The 3,144 counties of the 50 states and DC in data/reference/county_covariates.csv.

labels.severe: severity_score 3 or 4 in data/processed/restrictions.csv; pending instruments are capped at 2 and never count; NREL rows (status unknown) count as in force.
labels.touches: every county in county_fips_all: the county itself or a place within it.
labels.year: year of date_enacted_iso, else the first four-digit year in date_text; none means undated.

primary.name: new_severe_2022_2025
primary.frame: at_risk_2022 = 1: no dated severe restriction before 2022 and no undated severe restriction
primary.positive: the county's first severe restriction is dated 2022 to 2025

held_back.name: new_severe_2026
held_back.use: out-of-time check only: the primary model, refit on the full 2022 frame, scores the at-risk counties that had no severe restriction through 2025, and the 2026 first restrictions are compared with those scores. Never used to select or fit anything.

variables._note: The pool the selection rule starts from. log means natural log; log1p means log(1 + x). Missing values (two counties) take the frame median. Every variable is standardized inside each training fold.

log_population.as_of_note: ACS 2020-2024 stands in for 2021: a slow-moving attribute, measured partly after the cut

margin.from: county_covariates.margin_dr_2020 for the primary label, margin_dr_2024 for the snapshot labels

log1p_solar_mw.from: data/reference/facilities.csv: solar MW of plants operating or retired whose year is 2021 or earlier (primary) or any year (snapshot)

neighbor_severe_share.from: share of the county's neighbours (county_adjacency, 2024 boundaries) with a severe restriction dated before 2022 (primary) or at any date (snapshot)

log1p_queue_mw.from: data/reference/queue_projects.csv: solar, wind and storage MW of requests placed in the county with a request date before 2022 (primary) or any date (snapshot)

not_used.state siting law: data/processed/state_policies.csv records today's law, and several states changed who decides after 2021 (Illinois and Michigan in 2023), so it cannot be measured as of 2021. State effects are handled by the state-grouped cross-validation instead.
not_used.the county's own contested projects and: Sabin collects project fights and restrictions in the same research pass, so a county's own record count measures where sources looked.

method.model: L2-penalized logistic regression on standardized variables
method.selection: data-center-map's rule of 2026-08-26: at each C, backward elimination from the full pool, dropping while any coefficient changes sign across the 25 folds the variable that most evenly straddles zero (ties: smaller median magnitude, then name), never below 3 variables. A candidate is admissible when every coefficient keeps its sign in all 25 folds. Among admissible candidates: highest median AUC, then more variables, then smaller C. stability_cost (best median AUC of any candidate minus the admissible winner's) above 0.05 stops the run with no model.
method.blend: not ported: the lead candidate alone is reported, because nothing here reaches a page.
method.recalibration: logistic recalibration of the pooled out-of-fold logit, cross-fitted over 5 stratified folds so each county's calibrated score comes from a recalibration that did not see it.
method.state_grouped_cv: the selected candidate refit with 5-fold cross-validation grouped by state, reported beside the stratified result.
method.morans_i: on the residual (label minus calibrated score), row-standardized contiguity weights from county_adjacency, 999 permutations, seed 20261016. Diagnostic only.

calibration_gate.verdicts: PROMOTE when all pass; otherwise HOLD with the reasons. A model that holds is still reported.

sensitivity.name: nrel_only
sensitivity.what: the primary label and frame recomputed from NREL rows alone (nrel_at_risk_2022, nrel_new_severe_2022_2025), the selected variables refit
sensitivity.reading: if a variable changes sign or the rank order of counties changes materially (Spearman below 0.7 between the two scores), the all-source result is reported as reflecting where sources looked

sensitivity.name: without_nrel_year_positives
sensitivity.what: the primary frame without the counties whose positive label rests only on an NREL year (positive_rests_on_nrel_year), the selected variables refit

wording: Scores are a resemblance to counties that enacted severe restrictions, never a probability that a county will restrict. No score reaches a page, county report or headline figure without a separate decision by Price.
